channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Panera Bread: Mix and Match $4.99 Menu
item.description: Order up to 10 half-portion soups, salads, or sandwiches at $4.99 each — roughly 40% off regular prices — with no app or code required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Panera Bread: Buy One Entree, Get One for $5
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy One Entree, Get One for $5-2026-08-15
item.description: Use a limited-time Panera promo code at online or app checkout to get a second entree for just $5 with any full-price entree purchase. (Limited time)

item.title: Chilis: 3 For Me Bundle Starting at $10.99
item.guid: Chilis-3 For Me Bundle Starting at $10.99-2026-08-15
item.description: Get a drink, appetizer, and full entree in one sitting-down bundle for a stated price starting at $10.99 — order in-restaurant or via the Chilis app with no code needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: $4 Crinkle Cut Fries and $2 Sodas In-App
item.guid: Shake Shack-$4 Crinkle Cut Fries and $2 Sodas In-App-2026-08-15
item.description: Order on the Shake Shack app to get Crinkle Cut fries for $4 and fountain sodas for $2 at participating locations chain-wide — no code needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wingstop: 10 Bone-In Classic Wings for $10
item.description: Order bone-in classic wings directly on Wingstop.com or via the Wingstop app to lock in bundle pricing of $10 for 10 wings at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-15
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
